title: Zesty Deep-Fried Vietnamese Beef Bo Kho
description: A classic Vietnamese beef stew recipe with a twist, featuring crispy deep-fried beef and a side of sweet and tangy dipping sauce.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350°F.
Cut the beef into thin strips and fry in batches until crispy, about 3 minutes per batch.
Remove the fried beef from the oil and drain on paper towels.
In a separate saucepan, combine the beef broth, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and salt to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Return the fried beef to the saucepan and toss to coat with the sauce.
Serve the beef hot with a side of the sweet and tangy dipping sauce.
To make the dipping sauce, combine the sugar, water, and fish sauce in a small bowl and stir to combine.
Adjust the seasoning to taste with salt and pepper.
Serve the dipping sauce on the side of the beef.
Pour the dipping sauce over the beef and toss to coat.
Serve the beef and dipping sauce hot, garnished with sliced green onions and toasted peanuts if desired.
Toss the beef with the dipping sauce before serving, if desired.
Serve the beef hot, garnished with sliced green onions and toasted peanuts if desired.
